children: Overview
Canada aerospace and defence firm's Q3 revenue rose 24.9% from Q2, but dipped 0.9% yr/yr
Adjusted EBITDA loss narrowed 34.3% from sequentially, reflecting higher defence-related costs
Company awarded five-year Canadian Armed Forces contract and completed AISPECO acquisition post-quarter
Outlook
Volatus expects Adjusted EBITDA to improve as defence contracts convert to revenue
Company expects gross margins to rise as services and defence revenue increase into 2027
Result Drivers
DEFENCE PROGRAM MIX - Lower gross margin attributed to higher share of lower-margin defence programs in early delivery phase
COST INCREASES - Higher personnel, office, and marketing costs linked to defence expansion and Mirabel operations weighed on profitability
